test_Gemma3nAudioTower_end_to_end_shape: test that the Gemma3nAudioTower produces correct 3D output shape from mel features
test_Gemma3nAudioTower_temporal_reductio: test that temporal downsampling produces proportionally larger outputs for larger input sequences
test_Gemma3nAudioTower_projection_to_tex: test that audio features are projected to the text model dimension of 2048
test_Gemma3nAudioTower_different_batch_s: test that the audio tower handles batch sizes of 1, 2, and 4 correctly
test_Gemma3nAudioTower_gradient_flow: test that gradients flow through the subsample, encoder, and embedder components
